title: importing a missing module fails before execution

failure.justification: spec 5.2 makes this a module-resolution error without fixing whether it is reported by static analysis or when imports are loaded at run start; either way no program code runs.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 5.2: lookup checks import directories, the importer directory and the stdlib; nothing provides nowhere/missing.ok.
